newsitem.title: USA: Princess Diana, Mother Teresa meet in New York.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana, Mother Teresa meet in New York.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana met with Mother Teresa on Wednesday, taking time to greet well-wishers outside a New York City convent.
The princess and the Nobel Peace Prize winner waved to the crowd, and Mother Teresa hugged a baby outside the Missionaries of Charity residence in the Bronx.
The petite 86-year-old Mother Teresa appeared fit as she stood with the statuesque princess.
Known for her work with India's poor, the nun was admitted to a hospital three times last year for heart disease. She has stepped down as head of the Calcutta- based Missionaries of Charity order.
Mother Teresa arrived in New York late last month. Diana has been visiting the United States and attending an array of fund-raising events for charity.
The two met for about a half hour inside the convent and then emerged from the building, where they embraced and spoke briefly.
